decisions.reason: severity MEDIUM is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive via spring-boot-starter-logging → logback-classic. ACE requires Janino + writable config or env injection; low relevance for default Petclinic logging. Bump Spring Boot parent/plugin or set logback.version in Gradle ext / Maven properties (same pattern as existing tomcat/thymeleaf overrides).

decisions.reason: severity HIGH is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive via jackson-databind and Boot’s Jackson BOM. Highest fixes on the 2.x line used by Boot 3.5 are 2.21.7 (alternatively 2.22.3 on a newer BOM line). Async-parser DoS mainly affects reactive/async parsing; this app uses servlet MVC but still deserializes JSON via Spring MVC. Prefer raising the Boot-managed Jackson BOM; pin jackson-core only if the Boot 3.5.15 BOM remains below 2.21.7.

decisions.reason: severity HIGH is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive via spring-boot-starter-json / actuator. Several CVEs need 2.21.6–2.21.7; PTV bypass and related issues matter only if polymorphic typing or exotic bind targets are enabled (not typical in Petclinic). Align jackson-databind with jackson-core via Boot BOM or coordinated property overrides in both Gradle and Maven.

decisions.reason: severity HIGH is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive through spring-boot-starter-actuator. DoS via crafted HTTP/gRPC affects metrics instrumentation paths. Patch on the 1.15 line via Spring Boot 3.5.12+ (3.5.15 recommended for other co-dependencies).

decisions.reason: severity MEDIUM is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive via log4j-to-slf4j in Boot’s default logging bridge (SLF4J/Logback remains the backend). Issue affects MapMessage JSON layouts only; standard Logback text logging in Petclinic is unlikely to hit it. Managed by Boot BOM; upgrade parent or set log4j2.version.

decisions.reason: severity HIGH is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Declared directly in build.gradle (runtimeOnly) and pom.xml (runtime) without an explicit version; resolved from Spring Boot BOM. Used with application-postgres profile. Set postgresql.version in both builds (Maven property / Gradle ext) or add an explicit version; 42.7.12 is the highest fix across SCRAM/channel-binding issues.

decisions.reason: severity HIGH is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Jar is transitive from starters; version is defined by Gradle Boot plugin 3.5.0 and Maven spring-boot-starter-parent 3.5.0. CVE is local ApplicationTemp/session persistence abuse. Bump plugin + parent together to ≥3.5.15 (also satisfies related autoconfigure/actuator fixes).

decisions.reason: severity MEDIUM is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive via all starters. Embedded Artemis predictable path; Petclinic does not use embedded Artemis, so practical risk is low. Fixed only on Boot ≥3.5.15 for the 3.5 line—drives the minimum Boot bump above other Boot CVE minimums.

decisions.reason: severity HIGH is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Direct starter dependency (runtimeOnly in Gradle, compile in Maven). Health-group / Cloud Foundry path auth bypass when custom endpoints share actuator paths. Upgrade starter by bumping Boot to ≥3.5.12 (use 3.5.15 for autoconfigure parity); secure actuator endpoints in config if exposed.

decisions.reason: severity HIGH is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive via spring-data-jpa. DoS via property paths, sort parsing, and @ProjectedPayload when attacker-controlled query parameters reach Spring Data APIs—relevant to repository-backed MVC controllers. Pulled to 3.5.12 with Spring Boot ≥3.5.12.

decisions.reason: severity HIGH is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive; BOM-managed with other spring-* modules. Annotation resolution bug affects @EnableMethodSecurity on generic hierarchies; Petclinic does not appear to use method security. Fix at 6.2.11 via Boot BOM refresh (Boot 3.5.15 typically aligns Framework ≥6.2.11).

decisions.reason: severity HIGH is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive (spring-webmvc). SpEL DoS requires evaluating attacker-supplied expressions; standard Petclinic does not expose SpEL endpoints. Upgrade via Framework BOM from Spring Boot 3.5.x line (6.2.19 patches).

decisions.reason: severity MEDIUM is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive via spring-boot-starter-web. RFD needs ContentDisposition.filename(Charset) with unsanitized user filenames; SSRF needs UriComponentsBuilder on untrusted URLs. Petclinic is unlikely to use these APIs on attacker input. Brought to 6.2.19 with a Boot bump that updates the Framework BOM.

Transitive via spring-boot-starter-web. CVE-2026-47884 (XsltView RCE) and CVE-2026-47890 (SSE corruption) list fixes only on Framework 7.0.9 while 6.2.7–6.2.19 remain affected—full scanner clearance needs Spring Boot 4 / Framework 7 (major). Boot 3.5.15 + Framework 6.2.19 addresses the other listed CVEs on the 6.2 line. Petclinic uses Thymeleaf MVC, not XsltView or SSE view fragments, which limits exploitability but not advisory status.
